primary_sources.title: Truncation uncertainties for accurate quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories
primary_sources.reading_depth: Selected full-text reading: Sections 2.1 and 2.2, including equations 23–37 and their small-parameter conditions. Abstract/version metadata checked. Not a line-by-line audit of the entire paper or code.
supports: Context for representation truncation and boundary/Dyson mechanisms.
limitations: The inspected perturbative refinements are leading-order estimates under stated small-parameter assumptions.
The project factorial bound is independently derived and time-dependent; it does not inherit the paper’s time-independent refinement.
No claim of novelty or priority is made.

primary_sources.title: Exact Lattice Identities and Continuum-Limit Dyson–Schwinger Equations for Yang-Mills Theory
primary_sources.reading_depth: Selected full-text reading of the introduction and Sections II–V; explicit comparison of displayed equations 8, 14, 18 and 29 with the declared Hermitian-generator contract. No independent execution of author code and no audit of every downstream equation.
supports: The source distinguishes a formal continuum comparison and uses additional ghost/closure assumptions.
Displayed formula conventions define local algebra tests.
limitations: Exact finite Haar identities do not themselves construct the continuum theory.
Detected coefficient, source-phase and rank issues are limited to the displayed conventions and selected ansatz.
Failure of the defined point-concentration moment closure does not reject every scalar ansatz.
A variance variable is an existing observable, not an added physical field.
used_in: Root closure audit; separately executed fixtures required
